#### [BKV activates the interferon-β response in primary and immortalized microvascular endothelial cells late in the infectious cycle, resulting in persistence](<https://doi.org/10.1128/jvi.00934-26>)
*Lindsay C. Colgan, Ping An, Paul G. Cantalupo, Wenshan Zheng, Abigail R. Velasquez, Alexis M. Duray, Maria Teresa Sáenz Robles, David Weitz, James M. Pipas* <br>
Late-stage viral DNA replication and virion assembly trigger a heterogeneous interferon-β response across endothelial cells, upregulating canonical and novel interferon-stimulated genes to restrict subsequent rounds of infection and establish a long-term persistent reservoir.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
#### [Curvature-guided chiral collective organization of myoblast tissues](<https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.25.747076>)
*Yuan Shen, Rushikesh Shinde, Wang Xi, Sushil Dubey, Yoann Le Toquin, Joanna Da Costa Oterelo Martins, Lucas Anger, Andreas Schoenit, Gianluca Grenci, Christophe Marcelle, René-Marc Mège, Raphael Voituriez, Andrew Callan-Jones, Benoit Ladoux* <br>
Reversing surface curvature between convex and concave profiles flips the helical handedness of cellular assemblies through an actin-driven single-cell rotational bias while higher local curvature simultaneously delays myogenic differentiation.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
#### [The distribution of particle-associated                   Prochlorococcus                   across the global oceans](<https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.24.746807>)
*Maya I. Anjur-Dietrich, Nhi N. Vo, Katelyn G. Jones, James I. Mullet, Sierra M. Parker, Kurt G. Castro, Ashley M. Stein, Samantha M. Silvestri, Steven J. Biller, Krista Longnecker, Sallie W. Chisholm* <br>

:::
